geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the sealed dominant mass into a mass with a readable ground void on the access edge.
Match the public carve to the program access side.
Keep the void proportionally clear but not overly destructive to the main mass.

graph_edits.rationale: Introduce a true access-facing carve rather than leaving the mass sealed; this directly improves the public threshold on the verified frontage.
Keep the dominant compact proportion while opening the ground response; only modest global proportion change is needed.
Add a bounded public void as a clear usable neighborhood space, anchored to the existing dominant mass.
Align the void to the program's access side so the frontage becomes legible and semantically active.
Size the void as a meaningful but not over-carved public court.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all four views, with no obvious self-collision or view-dependent contradiction, so it clears the basic massing consistency gate. It reads as one compact object with a moderately stepped/profiled top rather than a fragmented composition, which supports gesture clarity and hierarchy. The main weakness is programmatic: for neighborhood living / mixed-use the diagram shows almost no legible public void, court, entry seam, or undercut on the verified access edge, so the ground response feels sealed and semantically weak. The parcel containment appears fine and the form is not over-clipped, but the mass is still close to a generic compact extrusion with a slight faceting treatment. Overall it is plausible for the brief only at an early massing stage, but it needs a clearer access-facing void or carve to become convincingly program-fit.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is a taller mixed-use tower language; the candidate is much lower and more compact, so only the hierarchy and stepped-slab clarity transfer.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact stacked/stepped mass can stay legible while preserving one strong dominant volume and a clear upper profile.
